Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode

Thank you. On behalf of Antique Limited, I would like to welcome all the participants to the Q2 
and H1 FY27 conference call of Raymond Realty Limited. Today, we have with us from the 
senior management of Raymond Realty Limited, Mr. Rakesh Tiwary, Group CFO, Mr. 
Harmohan Sahni, MD and CEO, Mr. Ankur Jindal, CFO, Mr. Salil Bawa, Group Head of

Harmohan Sahni: 
Thank you. Good morning, everyone and thank you for joining us today to discuss our financial 
and operational performance for the second quarter of financial year 2027. So, guided by our 
go-beyond ethos, we have successfully carried out the scaled execution and with strategic clarity 
from last year. We have walked into the first half of FY27. 
Our performance this quarter reflects strong operational momentum, validating our execution 
capabilities and deep trust home buyers place in our brand. I would now like to share the 
operational and financial updates for the quarter Q2 in detail. 
We achieved a landmark milestone this quarter by nearly doubling our quarterly pre-sales 
without any new launches, driven entirely by robust sales velocity and steady price realizations 
within our existing product portfolio. Total income for Q2 FY27 grew at a steady 7% year-on-
year to INR757 crores. 
And through an optimized product mix and disciplined cost management, our EBITDA also rose 
from 14% to INR115 crores with margins now at 15% as compared to 14% in the corresponding 
quarter. While our margins naturally fluctuate by project phase due to upfront marketing and 
construction setup costs, they are expected to normalize progressively as more of our projects 
go in mid-stage as this year progresses and moves into next year also. 
So, we are firmly on track to meet our full year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 17% to 19% 
and you will start seeing further improvements in the balance year. Our booking value 
contribution mix for the period reflects a well-balanced portfolio with projects outside of our 
legacy Thane land contributing 57% and Thane which is our owned land which started the 
business contributing 43%.

And this ratio will keep getting skewed more and more towards projects which are outside 
because most of the growth will come from outside of Thane. We also witnessed a 67% surge 
in customer collection to INR682 crores. This highlights our intense focus on cash flow 
efficiency and operational rigor. For the first half of the year, our cumulative collections have 
reached INR1,233 crores and booking values increased by 111% year-on-year to INR1,602 
crores. 
So, this quarter has been a standout operational achievement for us and one of the features of 
that was receiving the occupation certificate for Address by GS 1 Tower B in Thane, which 
comprises 270 units and almost 3.5 lakh square feet. 
And this also has been delivered ahead of RERA completion timeline as it has been a tradition 
for all our projects, we have delivered well before the timeline committed to the market and 
customers, so as a result, delivering ahead of schedule stands as a testament to our strong 
execution capability and operational efficiency. 
Our total portfolio now stands at an impressive GDV of approximately INR52,000 crores, which 
includes what we have added in H1 of approximately INR8,500 crores in Parel. So, this year 
itself we have added INR8,500 crores to reach this level of INR52,000 crores. So, this reflects a 
diversified and high-growth asset base across MMR, and as of now represents a prudent mix of 
own land and asset-light JDA projects. 
If you look at the Thana land parcel, which is a 100-acre parcel, that remains the launchpad on 
which this business started, and it carries a INR25,000 crores revenue potential. Out of this, 
approximately 65 acres is currently under development, which represents about 6.7 million 
square feet of RERA carpet area, and a revenue potential of INR16,500 crores. 
So out of this INR16,500 crores, INR9,770 crores has already been sold over the years, and 
collections have reached INR7,977 crores till date from the initiation of the business. Now, 
driven by our strategic pivot towards asset-light model, if we look at the JDA, JDA is now 
account for approximately 52% of our total GDV portfolio, which represents a revenue potential 
of INR27,000 crores at current prices. 
Now, within the JDA, if we look at all the projects, 4 projects which are the Bandra project, the 
BKC project, Wadala, and Sion have already been launched and they are progressing rapidly. 
And they have already generated for us over the last 2.5 to 3 years that we have launched this 
JDA-based model, they have already generated a sales value of INR3,432 crores and a collection 
of INR857 crores till date. And this will keep on growing as we go on. 
So, if we look at our booking value contribution mix for the period, that also reflects and follows 
a very similar pattern of the GDV, where non-Thane JDAs have contributed 57% of the presale 
value and Thane has contributed 43% of the sale value. 
So, while there is a mix, if you see, INR25,000 crores versus INR27,000 crores in terms of GDV, 
but the sale contribution of JDAs is higher as compared to the Thana land because they are 
distributed across various micro markets and the potential to grow over there is much higher.

Now let's -- if you look at our balance sheet, we maintained a highly disciplined approach to 
capital allocation. We closed the quarter with a net debt of INR912 crores and a gross debt of 
INR1,200-odd crores with a healthy debt-to-equity ratio of 0.8x. 
If you look at the net debt-to-equity ratio, which it will be closer to 0.5, so which remains 
comfortably well below our 1:1 ceiling and gives us ample headroom for growth going forward. 
Now, backed by INR308 crores liquidity buffer and a stable cost of debt at 9.6%, we are 
comfortably funded for our construction requirements over the current year. 
Additionally, total interest cost for Q2 FY27 is INR44 crores, which includes interest on bank 
borrowings of INR27 crores and INR17 crores of interest to government authorities for various 
approval payments which get paid over a period of time, particularly agencies like BMC, TMC, 
and MHADA, where the approval costs get paid over a period of time, and on the balance, the 
government charges a nominal interest without any documentation. 
 
Regarding our cash flows, if we look at, we have also shared a detailed breakdown of our first 
half FY27 cash flows on -- in as a part of our investor deck, you can refer to Slide Number 23 
of our investor presentation. You will see that our existing mature projects continue to deliver 
strong operating cash flows, which is being reinvested into recently launched and new yet to be 
launched projects. 
 
The reason we have broken it up is because it gives you a better insight and it will help you 
understand in greater detail how the cash flow cycle for various projects move as they move 
from early stage to mid-stage and then late stage. And as -- is typical for any new JDA project, 
it remains cash flow negative for the first 2 years due to upfront investments and then becomes 
cash flow positive from third year or middle of third year onwards and then so it goes on towards 
positivity after that. 
 
So, all our projects have very healthy IRRs and strong underlying cash flows. There, therefore, 
as these projects mature, we shall see the cash flows improving. Once we reach a steady state in 
terms of 8 to 10 projects outside of Thane, which will be so -- which will be under execution 
and start throwing out cash and Thane is already net cash positive, you can see. 
 
So, between these two, I think within -- I mean, my estimate is that within a period of 2 years, 
we will reach that steady state and you will start seeing much more stability in cash flows, much 
more stability even on quarterly -- quarter-on-quarter numbers because the hyper growth phase 
will start to stabilize in the next 2 years. Just now in the last 6 years and we are continuing in 
that hyper growth phase, which requires a lot of capital and we have done this growth profitably. 
 
It's always a challenge to display a profitable growth, but happy to share with you that your 
company has managed to grow in a profitable manner and yet maintained the financial discipline 
of not exceeding 1:1 debt-equity.

a lot of people have asked me that your interest charge has gone up and the debt level has gone 
up, which is a fact, but if you compare it with last year, the last year the debt level was extremely

schedule and balance will be as has been approved by the shareholders in their -- in the AGM.

crores as part of the peak investment, which would represent almost 60% of the peak investment 
that project, particular project needs. So, this is -- this joint equity investment will directly fund 
the high-value redevelopment project in one of the Mumbai's very premium micro markets. 
 
And this transaction actually validates our very disciplined asset-light expansion strategy where 
we continue to spread our risk as the project moves on and accelerates and we keep de-risking 
ourselves and share the risk with other market participants.  
It allows us to accelerate project timelines, it allows us to grow even faster than we have grown 
in the past and also the most important part is it keeps our capital efficiency at an optimum level, 
which is what the endeavor is. So, by leveraging this institutional capital, we can scale across 
premium micro markets without over-leveraging our balance sheet, ensuring strong project 
delivery and enhanced returns. That's the conclusion of working on the cap table. 
Now, looking ahead, if you see, we are accelerating our growth trajectory over the next two 
quarters. So, H2 will see two launches from us. Both of these launches are going to be in Mahim. 
The combined GDV of these projects is about INR4,100 crores approximately. Now -- so with 
a clear strategy and the land parcel that we have in Thane and a GDV pipeline which is already 
signed up plus there are more JDAs which are in the pipeline which we will be signing going 
forward.
